Shifting the uniformly convergent geometric series gives rho H(t+theta)-H(t)=2Phi(t), with A_m-rho^m H(m theta)=2-H(0). Irrationality follows also because 2cos(2theta)=11/7 cannot be a rational algebraic integer, as it would be if exp(2i theta) were a root of unity. Irrational rotation equidistributes modulo pi/3, and the vanishing error gives the empirical law for uniform sampling of exponents. The support is the full connected image of H, since every neighborhood of an attained value has preimage of positive phase measure; the functional equation precludes a constant H. On [0,pi/3] the cosine range is sqrt(3)cos(t-pi/6); its Fourier coefficient is 3sqrt(3)/(pi(1-36l^2)). Summing the geometric shift gives the stated H coefficients, whose absolute summability follows from rho>1; taking the constant and applying Parseval gives the mean and variance with the stated normalization.
